target_policy.merge_strategy: Record every unique change semantically, then use non-fast-forward ours merges to retain main and realtime ancestry without importing rejected or superseded tree content.

main_unique_commits.subject: Revert main to stable runtime baseline
main_unique_commits.reason: The commit removes the architecture-hardening product tree and is not the selected final product baseline.

main_unique_commits.subject: Publish transformed odometry twist
main_unique_commits.reason: nav_msgs/Odometry requires twist in child_frame_id, while the upstream FAST_LIO message publishes world-frame state velocity and body-frame IMU angular velocity under one body child_frame_id. Applying one map-from-odom rotation to both fields cannot make the mixed input contract correct. Publishing unknown zero twist is safer than publishing a plausible but falsely framed velocity.

realtime_unique_commits.subject: Optimize n3mapping realtime tracking cache
realtime_unique_commits.reason: Recovery has the evolved multi-level PreparedTarget and bounded target-provider/tracking caches.

realtime_unique_commits.subject: Move n3mapping target builds to background
realtime_unique_commits.reason: Recovery has bounded asynchronous loaded-map target prefetch, map-revision invalidation, and transition coverage; FA-01 passed on the selected tree.

realtime_unique_commits.subject: Scale n3mapping target cache with map size
realtime_unique_commits.reason: Recovery uses explicit bounded cache budgets rather than an unbounded map-size-derived policy; FA-01 passed.

realtime_unique_commits.subject: Stop odometry output before localization lock
realtime_unique_commits.reason: Recovery uses RelocalizationOutputAuthority to suppress global pose until the typed state and pose source make it usable.

realtime_unique_commits.subject: Remove realtime odometry shadow output
realtime_unique_commits.reason: The realtime shadow output is already absent from the recovery target tree.

realtime_unique_commits.subject: Relax tracking acceptance for stable GICP matches
realtime_unique_commits.reason: It accepts a non-converged registration from fitness, inlier, and motion gates. Recovery requires converged, finite, rigid registration before tracking acceptance.

realtime_unique_commits.subject: Publish N3Mapping localization status
realtime_unique_commits.reason: No active workspace consumer of /n3mapping/status was found. Recovery publishes the typed, reliable, transient-local RelocalizationStatus interface in both Humble and Noetic and derives pose publication from the same output authority. The Noetic-only JSON heartbeat would duplicate state without a compatibility consumer.
